title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
slides: AI promised managers productivity—why the headache?
Most tools still demand more oversight, not less
The real bottleneck: managers can't verify AI's output
Start with one auditable task you already measure
Demand tools that show their work, or skip them
thread_text:
1. The AI productivity illusion

Managers were promised less work, but most tools add oversight—every output needs a second look. The headache is real.

2. Oversight is the new workload

Instead of saving time, AI often creates a review queue. You're not managing less; you're managing differently.

3. The verification bottleneck

Managers can't easily check AI's work, so trust erodes. Without transparency, every output becomes a mini-audit.

4. Start with one auditable task

Pick a task you already measure—like report generation—and test AI there. Measurable results beat vague promises.

5. Demand tools that show their work

If a tool can't explain its output, skip it. Try one task this week and see if the oversight outweighs the gain.
